label: Potion counter
description: Healing potions or soup left in your inventory.
settings_description: Settings for the Potion counter HUD mod. Reads `counts` on the tick payload, the same inventory-wide sensor the Item counter's named items use: `health_potion` is every splash potion of Healing (I and II) in the inventory and `soup` is every bowl of mushroom stew. A separate mod rather than two more `item_counter.track` values because the two are read at different moments: the item counter answers what you are building or throwing with, and this answers how many heals are left, which is the one number a pot or soup fight is decided by and the one worth a chip of its own.

default_placement.note: Directly above the Item counter (`-146`) in the 175 column, on the same 38 px rhythm: the hand-and-clicks corner reads, bottom to top, how fast the hand is going (CPS), what it is going through (Item counter) and how many heals are left.

track.description: What is counted: splash potions of Healing, bowls of mushroom stew, or both side by side.

show_label.description: Whether the count is followed by its unit, `pots` or `soup`. With `both` the units are what tell the two figures apart, so they are always drawn there.

low_threshold.description: A count at or below this many draws in the warn treatment. Unlike the Item counter this has a non-zero default, because what is in the slot is known: three heals is low in every pot and soup mode. 0 disables the warning.
